SEATS FILED AHEAD OF THE GLM WALL (23:51-23:57). They are not READY yet; I will name each one when it comes up.
OPUS, ONE ONLY: the plan's only Opus lead row is Opus 5.5 max on ref-e44df808f581ff079ac4, which has 1 free seat (3 of 4). ref-a31873e5ad9108cdd2cc has no Opus lead row tonight. Filed: ref-55cff924be25afe6f9dd. ref-4189c1615990eb515921 is working your card.
CODEX (the CO's codex-first order; gpt-6-astra max): the in-place Muse move refused at the door ('a pool restart is defined for claude only, not muse'), and a Muse session cannot resume under Codex. So these are fresh seats. The Muse seats and their records stay untouched for the hand-off.
- 005 relief: ref-4bc9297546b34b47e7f1
- 006 relief: ref-2d84809e48a6f43e316f (on codex at 23:55)
- 008 relief: ref-a7e30432389a4638aaa5
- checker relief: ref-baa4584cf36c531365e7. Its job 018 now runs on GLM 73a2544, so this seat can take 018 back at the wall.
- GLM reliefs: ref-fd33765b99866c31a369 and ref-12b2327f63d80a6d5cdd
That covers GLM's four jobs: the Opus seat, the two GLM reliefs and the checker relief. After these, every pool is at its cap: codex 8 of 8, provider-pool 4 of 4, grok 4 of 4, glm 6 of 6. Any further seat needs a retirement first. Re-point each card, and brief the new seat with the path to its old record.
